sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports
sections.what: Brings in the AI helper, the prompt builder, and the result type, and sets the Node.js runtime.
sections.why: Needed to build the prompt and call the AI.

sections.name: POST
sections.title: Natural language update handler
sections.what: Sends the user's sentence and current app data to the AI and returns the update it proposes.
sections.why: Turns free text into something the app can apply.
sections.watch_out: The AI result is returned as is, so a bad result passes straight through.

summary: Turns a plain sentence from the user into a structured update to their application data.
purpose: Lets users type changes in everyday language.
why: Likely reason: typing a sentence is easier than filling in forms.
how: Checks the text and app data are present, builds the prompt, asks the AI for a JSON result, and returns it.
inputs: Text, the app data, and optional provider settings.
outputs: The AI's structured result, or an error with status 400 or 500.
risks: The route returns the AI result without checking its shape. A misreading could change data if the caller applies it.
debug: Parse failures: check the AI reply and the prompt built by nlUpdatePrompt in lib/prompts.
